content: pandas OHLCV aggregation pitfalls: resample() aggregates but does NOT insert bars for missing periods - silently returns fewer rows on gaps unless .asfreq() or explicit reindex is chained afterward; conflating resample (change frequency by aggregation) with reindex (fill an existing index) is a common source of silent bugs in quant code; without an explicit origin/offset parameter, resampled bin boundaries may not align with exchange-native candle boundaries, which is exactly the kind of boundary-definition ambiguity flagged for 6h-from-60m aggregation in RESEARCH.md.
